parties: Sonia Agarwal Bajaj (acquirer) / Donear Industries Limited
headline: Sonia Agarwal Bajaj files SEBI Takeover disclosure for Donear Industries
sum: Sonia Agarwal Bajaj has filed a Regulation 10(5) disclosure under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, signalling a material shareholding change in Donear Industries Limited.
implication: Regulation 10(5) disclosure is mandatory when an acquirer crosses 25% threshold or intends substantial acquisition; the filing triggers open offer obligations and triggers review of insider information protocols and trading windows.
detail: The disclosure was filed with NSE on 24 August 2026 by Sonia Agarwal Bajaj under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 10(5) requires disclosure of intent, timing, and structure of acquisition once the threshold is crossed or immediately before crossing. The filing does not disclose the quantum of shares, acquisition price, or proposed open offer terms in the abstract provided, requiring reference to the full PDF for those details.
